questions.text: By 2030, I _____ studying English for 5 years.
questions.explanation: To talk about an ongoing action until a point in the future, we use Future Perfect Continuous: will have been + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: للتحدث عن إجراء مستمر حتى نقطة في المستقبل، نستخدم المستقبل التام المستمر: will have been + V-ing.

questions.text: By next June, they _____ working here for 10 years.
questions.explanation: We use Future Perfect Continuous to emphasize duration up to a future time.
questions.explanationAr: نستخدم المستقبل التام المستمر للتأكيد على المدة حتى وقت في المستقبل.

questions.text: By December, she _____ living in Dubai for 3 years.
questions.explanation: With 'she', we still use 'will have been'. Never use 'will has been'.
questions.explanationAr: مع 'she'، لا نزال نستخدم 'will have been'. لا تستخدم أبدًا 'will has been'.

questions.text: I _____ working here for long by next month.
questions.explanation: The negative form is 'will not have been' or 'won't have been' + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: الصيغة المنفية هي 'will not have been' أو 'won't have been' + V-ing.

questions.text: They _____ waiting for more than an hour by 5 p.m.
questions.explanation: The negative form is 'won't have been' + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: الصيغة المنفية هي 'won't have been' + V-ing.

questions.text: She _____ studying all day by the time you call.
questions.explanation: The negative form is 'will not have been' + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: الصيغة المنفية هي 'will not have been' + V-ing.

questions.text: _____ you have been studying for 3 hours by 10 p.m.?
questions.explanation: Questions in the Future Perfect Continuous start with 'Will'.
questions.explanationAr: تبدأ الأسئلة في المستقبل التام المستمر بـ 'Will'.

questions.text: _____ they have been working here for 8 years by 2030?
questions.explanation: Questions start with 'Will'.
questions.explanationAr: تبدأ الأسئلة بـ 'Will'.

questions.text: _____ she have been living in London for long by then?
questions.explanation: Questions start with 'Will'.
questions.explanationAr: تبدأ الأسئلة بـ 'Will'.

questions.text: Will you have been studying? Yes, I _____.
questions.explanation: The short affirmative answer is 'Yes, I will'.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة المثبتة هي 'Yes, I will'.

questions.text: Will they have been working? No, they _____.
questions.explanation: The short negative answer is 'No, they won't'.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة المنفية هي 'No, they won't'.

questions.text: What does the Future Perfect Continuous emphasize?
options: Duration of an action up to a future time
A completed action in the past
questions.correctAnswer: Duration of an action up to a future time
questions.explanation: It emphasizes how long an action will continue up to a future time.
questions.explanationAr: إنه يؤكد على المدة التي سيستمر فيها الإجراء حتى وقت في المستقبل.

questions.text: What is the structure of the Future Perfect Continuous?
questions.explanation: The structure is 'will have been' followed by a verb ending in -ing.
questions.explanationAr: التركيبة هي 'will have been' متبوعة بفعل ينتهي بـ -ing.

questions.text: By next year, I will have been _____ for 15 years.
questions.explanation: After 'will have been', we use the V-ing form.
questions.explanationAr: بعد 'will have been'، نستخدم صيغة V-ing.

questions.text: By 2028, they will have been _____ around the world for 3 years.
questions.explanation: After 'will have been', we use the V-ing form.
questions.explanationAr: بعد 'will have been'، نستخدم صيغة V-ing.

questions.text: Which of these pairs of signal words is common in Future Perfect Continuous?
questions.explanation: We often use 'for' (to show duration) and 'by' (to show the future point).
questions.explanationAr: غالبًا ما نستخدم 'for' (لإظهار المدة) و 'by' (لإظهار نقطة المستقبل).

questions.text: She will have been _____ piano for 4 years by next month.
questions.explanation: After 'will have been', we use the V-ing form.
questions.explanationAr: بعد 'will have been'، نستخدم صيغة V-ing.

questions.text: They won't have _____ waiting long.
questions.explanation: The structure is won't + have + been + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: التركيبة هي won't + have + been + V-ing.

questions.text: Will she have _____ working?
questions.explanation: The structure is Will + Subject + have + been + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: التركيبة هي Will + الفاعل + have + been + V-ing.

questions.text: I will have been working on this project _____ 6 months by July.
questions.explanation: Use 'for' to express the duration of 6 months.
questions.explanationAr: استخدم 'for' للتعبير عن مدة 6 أشهر.

questions.text: 'I will be studying for 5 years by 2030.' is the best way to emphasize duration.
questions.explanation: Future Continuous just says it will be happening. To emphasize the duration up to 2030, use Future Perfect Continuous: 'I will have been studying...'
questions.explanationAr: المستقبل المستمر يقول فقط أنه سيحدث. للتأكيد على المدة حتى عام 2030، استخدم المستقبل التام المستمر: 'I will have been studying...'

questions.text: 'They will have studied here for 8 years by 2030.' is preferred over 'They will have been studying...'
questions.explanation: While grammatically possible, 'will have been studying' is heavily preferred to emphasize the continuous duration of an action.
questions.explanationAr: على الرغم من أنه ممكن نحويًا، إلا أنه يُفضل بشدة استخدام 'will have been studying' للتأكيد على المدة المستمرة للإجراء.

questions.text: 'Will you be working here for long by next year?' is the correct question to emphasize duration.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. To emphasize duration by a future time, use: 'Will you have been working here for long by next year?'
questions.explanationAr: إنه غير صحيح. للتأكيد على المدة بحلول وقت في المستقبل، استخدم: 'Will you have been working here for long by next year?'

questions.text: The Future Perfect Continuous focuses on how long an action will continue up to a future time.
questions.explanation: It is true. This is the primary usage of this tense.
questions.explanationAr: إنه صحيح. هذا هو الاستخدام الأساسي لهذا الزمن.

questions.text: 'By next month, I will have been teaching for 15 years.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is correct. It uses 'by' for the future point and 'for' to show duration, with 'will have been teaching'.
questions.explanationAr: إنه صحيح. يستخدم 'by' للنقطة المستقبلية و 'for' لإظهار المدة، مع 'will have been teaching'.
